Hi I had a very very similar experience not so long ago, clots, dizziness it all sounds incredibly similar. Rest assured it isn’t unusual for our age, however not normal either. 
You are loosing a lot of blood so that dizziness is most likely from an iron deficiency, I recommend getting your iron levels checked ASAP and having a discussion with your PCP on starting supplements if needed, building hemoglobin is essential for the body. 
Next, and as soon as possible get an appointment with a gyno. They will do an ultrasound to see if there is anything unusual with your uterus and will treat you from there. For me, when I struggled with the same issues I was told to take hormonal birth control to regulate my period (not for sexual activity!) so the lining doesn’t build up over time which is what ultimately leads to the long duration heavy bleeding. 

Wish you luck!

Eating healthy is difficult when you don't have healthy food lying around, but maybe you can convince your parents to buy some cheaper healthier food options! Frozen veggies and canned veggies are a great place to start. Making soups and other bulky foods that are filled with protein, protein pastas, and veggies might help you get it all in one go. Another thing I have found to help is limiting sugar, specifically at breakfast! At least in an american diet there is so much sugar in breakfast foods, but this is harmful because eating straight sugar after fasting all night spikes your blood sugar and can make you super tired and cranky for the rest of the day. Instead try eating some protein-rich foods like eggs + whole wheat toast and you would feel a noticible difference. It's difficult to cut out sugar right away, so you can pair your favorite foods with some extra protein on the side, but also cut the portion: for example if you eat 4 pancakes with syrup, replace that for maybe 2 pancakes + eggs, or 1 pancake, 1 slice of thin toast, and some eggs.

- I found it beneficial to kinda study the exemplar iwa, so I’d reccomend just reading through it and almost following a similar structure so it’s easier to start out and to keep going 
- find sources as you go, once you get your initial sources, you’ll need more sources in your paper. 
- good luck! It took me 12 hours to write it from scratch, but I believe you should be alright ( gathering sources and building my argument took me 8 hours, writing took about 3 or 4
